title: Data visualization / Usage

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Adapt information density to the viewer’s task so monitoring remains coherent and communication remains clear.
strategic_value: A shared chart language can connect IBM product dashboards with simpler marketing and editorial uses.
demonstration: Dense dashboards and multi-device screens appear above isolated marketing charts, figures and illustrative data treatments.
practical_value: Choose coordinated chart sets for monitoring and a simpler focused message for editorial or marketing work.

content_islands.name: Product and dashboard applications
content_islands.spec: Group dark dashboards, monitoring screens and related analytical views under the first section.

content_islands.name: Marketing applications
content_islands.spec: Follow with presentation graphics, tablet and mobile examples, percentage figures and abstract dimensional charts.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text distinguishes multi-perspective monitoring from marketing situations where a simple message matters most.
reference_purposes.Expression: Charts share restrained typography, dark fields and selective saturated color.
reference_purposes.Application: The two galleries apply data-visualization guidance in product and marketing contexts.
